releaseNotes: v1.2.5 -- Fixes excessive hub load on lower-spec hubs and adds adjustable logging levels. Both component drivers now only call sendEvent() when a value actually changed, instead of unconditionally on every poll -- this was tripping Hubitat's 'excessive hub load' protection on hubs with less headroom than a C-8 Pro (e.g. a base C-8). The old single 'Enable debug logging' toggle has been replaced with a 3-level Log level dropdown: Errors Only, Normal (default), and Full. Normal shows meaningful one-time events and real state transitions (login, asleep/awake changes, devices created, config changes) without the noise of routine unchanged polls. Full shows everything, including every poll step, for chasing something intermittent, and automatically reverts to Normal after 60 minutes. No action needed on update; existing installs default to Normal logging. Thanks to @kylemcdonald87 for the hub load reports that led to tracking this down. Also includes v1.2.3 (dashboard snapshot tiles: fixed broken-image icon and a slow/hanging issue on busy dashboards via hub-side snapshot caching on its own schedule; fixed a scheduling bug where only one camera of several would actually poll; self-healing scheduler that survives a hub reboot; fixed wired devices defaulting to the loose battery poll interval; fixed the Refresh command doing nothing; Poll interval and Snapshot interval are now device-only settings), v1.2.2 (fixed snapshot tiles breaking once the camera's session token expired or was invalidated by another client; added an OAuth requirement, enabled automatically by HPM on update), v1.2.1 (diagnostic logging fix for calls that returned no usable value), and v1.2.0 (PTZ calibration support, reorganized device page command grouping).
